convert_tensor_to_numpy: convert a PyTorch tensor to a NumPy array using the to_numpy function
convert_numpy_to_tensor: convert a NumPy array to a PyTorch tensor on a specified device using to_tensor
extract_scalar_from_tensor: extract a scalar value from a single-element PyTorch tensor using the to_scalar function
extract_scalar_from_numpy: extract a scalar value from a single-element NumPy array using the to_scalar function
convert_tensor_to_scalar: convert a single-element PyTorch tensor to a Python int or float scalar using to_scalar
